summary: A generative 90s eurodance firmware: press PLAY and it writes and plays a whole song with bass, stabs, a hook, a choir and a key change, which you steer with four knobs.
features: Ten styles in CLUB and RADIO sets, each with many songs
Song form: intro, verse, pre-chorus, chorus, break, key-up last chorus
Four knobs: LIFT filter, PUMP ducking, VOX choir and ENERGY
Play the hook live on the keys; BREAK and KEY UP buttons
16 sounds per part; synthesised drums and a formant choir
MIDI out per part; uses Felucca's first two song slots
